DEXTERITY.desc: Dexterity is used in combat to determine your chance of melee/ranged evasion, it is also used to evade a Trap after triggering one. The formula for combat evasion is ((Dexterity / Level) * 4) = Evasion percent chance, evasion is capped at 40% (+10% from attack evasion) so higher than 10000 wont provide any noticeable difference for combat.
DEXTERITY.name: Dexterity

HITPOINTS.desc: Your Health is used in combat, each time you are hit by a spell or weapon your health will go down, when it reaches 0 or less you will be dead and lose the fight. Therefore the more health you have the longer you will survive.
HITPOINTS.name: Hitpoints

INTELLIGENCE.desc: Your Intelligence along with your mana determines what spells you can use it may also be used when disarming traps. Also your intelligence provides you with a bonus to your mana pool of 1pt mana for each point of intelligence. Intelligence may also improve damage spells in combat.
INTELLIGENCE.name: Intelligence

MANA.desc: Your Mana determines what spells you may cast both in combat and outside of combat, each time you cast a spell your mana goes down, you may need to rest to regenerate your mana.
MANA.name: Mana

MAXHITPOINTS.desc: Your Health is used in combat, each time you are hit by a spell or weapon your health will go down, when it reaches 0 or less you will be dead and lose the fight. Therefore the more health you have the longer you will survive.
MAXHITPOINTS.name: Max Hitpoints

MAXMANA.desc: Your Mana determines what spells you may cast both in combat and outside of combat, each time you cast a spell your mana goes down, you may need to rest to regenerate your mana.
MAXMANA.name: Max Mana

MAXSTAMINA.desc: Your Stamina determines what styles you may execute in combat, each time you execute a style your stamina goes down, you may need to rest to regenerate your stamina. Stamina also plays a part in increasing your hitpoints, for every 5pts of stamina you gain 1pt bonus point of health.
MAXSTAMINA.name: Max Stamina

SPEED.desc: Speed is used in combat to determine your chance of spell evasion. The formula for spell evasion is ((Speed / Level) * 4) = Evasion percent chance, evasion is capped at 40% (or 50% including Spell evasion skill) so higher than 10000 wont provide any noticeable difference for combat.
SPEED.name: Speed

STAMINA.desc: Your Stamina determines what styles you may execute in combat, each time you execute a style your stamina goes down, you may need to rest to regenerate your stamina. Stamina also plays a part in increasing your hitpoints, for every 5pts of stamina you gain 1pt bonus point of health.
STAMINA.name: Stamina

STRENGTH.desc: Your Strength improves your damage with melee weapons using the equation Damage = Damage + (STR / 10). This means for every 10pts you have in Strength you will deal 1 more damage.
STRENGTH.name: Strength
